description:
Render one of a style's two template images — a REAL step of style
    setup, not an optional extra: a style isn't finished until both its
    character and environment templates are rendered (the app shows them on
    the style card). Asset reference images render against them (characters →
    character template; environments and objects → environment template), and
    segment renders fall back on them when a shot has no asset reference — so
    finish BOTH before generate_asset_reference. Run once per template_type
    ("character" | "environment") for every new style; skip types the style
    already has (get_style's `templates`). A template already exists is a hard
    stop here — the call refuses unless replace=True, because overwriting one
    silently re-anchors every future render. Async — await_jobs(style_id=...),
    then get_style.

editable_sections.description: Per-call prompt section overrides, keyed by section name; see get_section_template for the template job
editable_sections.title: Editable Sections

model.description: Image model ID; empty uses the template job's default (see list_models)
model.title: Model

replace.description: Set True ONLY to deliberately overwrite an existing template of this type — the user must have asked for a new one. Leave False and the call refuses rather than clobbering a template the style already has
replace.title: Replace

style_id.description: Style ID, as returned by create_style or list_styles
style_id.title: Style Id

template_type.description: Which of the style's two template images to render: "character" or "environment" — run once for each
template_type.title: Template Type
